title: An Extremal Formula for Elliptical Width and the Bourin--Lee Conjecture
summary:
Let \(X\in M_n(\mathbb C)\), \(n\geq2\), and let \[ δ_2(X) = \sup_{\dim S=2}δ(X_S), \] where \(X_S\) denotes the compression of \(X\) to \(S\), and \(δ(X_S)\) is the diameter of the largest disk contained in the numerical range \(W(X_S)\). Bourin and Lee proved that every positive block matrix \[ M=  egin{pmatrix} A&X X^*&B \end{pmatrix} \] satisfies \[

orm{A+B}+δ_2(X). \] In the same work, they conjectured that the inequality \[ 
orm{M}\leq
orm{A+B} \] for every positive block matrix with prescribed off-diagonal block \(X\) characterizes essentially Hermitian matrices. We…
